sections.heading: 0.1.0-alpha.7
paragraphs: The first configured build with the alpha channel: updates are checked automatically; download and installation require user confirmation.
A personal alpha for testing the first installation and future updates. This is not a stable release.

sections.heading: Checks that the bytes match. It does not replace a publisher’s digital signature.
Alpha
paragraphs: Updates are checked automatically; download and installation require confirmation.

sections.heading: Added
paragraphs: A unified update mechanism that verifies signed TUF data, installer size, and SHA-256.
Update window to check, download, update, and restart; UAC is still required.
Protection for unfinished conversations, drafts, and attachments before updating.
Safe diagnostics for update stages and a memory-readiness check after restart.

sections.heading: Known limitations
paragraphs: The EXE has no Windows Authenticode signature yet: “Unknown publisher” or a SmartScreen warning or block is possible. Do not bypass SmartScreen or disable Windows protection.
A real installed A → B update, repair, and clean-PC test are still pending; local checks do not replace them.
Alpha.2 has no updater. This version is a new initial installation, not an automatic transition from alpha.2.
Technical minimum: Windows 10 x86_64 build 17763; compatibility with every supported Windows version and GPU has not yet been verified.
